revised_prompt:
Create a polished high-fidelity mobile webpage UI concept at exactly 1024x1536 portrait, edge-to-edge with no phone mockup, no device frame, no browser chrome. English interface for logistics brand “FreightVanta”, visually inspired only by a clean white header, deep navy typography, cobalt blue action color, pale blue-gray page canvas, thin cool-gray borders. This is a realistic single-column mobile product calculator screen, NOT a shrunken desktop page, NOT an advertisement, NOT a dashboard collage. No photos, no decorative charts, no hero artwork.

Layout: pale blue-gray background, white cards, generous mobile padding about 48 px, refined modern sans-serif typography, aligned amounts on right. At top compact white header: blue square geometric FreightVanta mark, wordmark “FreightVanta” in navy, hamburger menu on right. Under it breadcrumb “Tools  /  Duty & tax”. H1 “Import Duty & Tax Calculator”, short subtitle “Budget your import costs before you ship.” Include a visible pale blue outlined notice bar with uppercase text “DESIGN PREVIEW — Illustrative data only.”

Then a white rounded shipment summary card titled “Shipment summary” with a blue text button “Edit details” on right. Structured compact details with readable labels and values: Destination “United States”; Origin “China”; HTS “6109100012” with a small outlined chip “Example code”; Goods “USD 1,000.00”; Customs value “USD 1,000.00”; Mode “Air freight”. Then label “Incoterms” and an accessible two-option segmented selector with equal large tap targets: “DDP” and “DAP”, with DAP visibly selected cobalt blue and DDP unselected white. Under selector: “Import charges are normally paid by the buyer under DAP.”

Next prominent white result panel with a restrained amber top/accent status strip/icon and heading “Partial estimate” followed by “— additional duties need review.” Explain subtly “Known charges only”. Itemized rows with dividers and right-aligned values: “Example base duty 5%” / “USD 50.00”; “Additional duties” / amber outlined badge “Needs review”; “Import VAT” / “Not applicable”; “Government fees” / amber outlined badge “Needs review”; “Clearance service” / “Not provided”. Make unknown statuses visibly distinct from zero values. At bottom separated summary row: “Known charges subtotal” and bold “USD 50.00”. Directly beneath in clear dark text: “This is not your total import cost.” Do NOT show any complete tax total, landed-cost total, grand total, or numeric complete total.

Below it white card headed “What needs checking” with exactly three concise rows and small blue circular/check/arrow icons: “Origin-specific additional measures”; “Entry type and government fees”; “Brokerage and delivery charges”.

Bottom actions stacked with large accessible touch controls: full-width cobalt blue primary button “Verify & request a quote”; white outlined secondary button “Edit shipment”; quiet centered text action with tiny printer icon “Print summary”. Finish with compact Sources & assumptions disclosure card: heading “Sources & assumptions”, then readable legal copy: “Example base duty is illustrative. Classification, origin measures, government fees and service charges require confirmation before entry.” Keep a little bottom spacing.

Ensure all requested wording is legible, accurate, and coherent. Strong visual hierarchy, crisp UI, restrained cobalt and amber accents, fine borders, natural mobile spacing. Screenshot aesthetic of a finished responsive web product at 1024x1536.
